'''2000 Massachusetts State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament for Massachusetts in 2000. The winner is unknown.<ref name="ls120">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls120.htm Strangle], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001030052636/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls120.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Date:''' 2000
* '''Site:''' Massachusetts
* '''Winner:''' Unknown

== Dating ==

Dan Mailloux played this deck at "the Massachusetts State Championships" and went 2–1 (+35). The page names Third Anthology as its latest expansion, and Trandosite captured it on 30 October 2000. That points to the 2000 state championships rather than 1999.
